notes.title: Reborn a Zombie 2 - Progress update
notes.notes:
Greetings, it's been a while! Do not worry, Reborn a Zombie is not dead, quite the contrary!
Reborn a Zombie 1's update status: On hold
Wait, there was an update planned?

Indeed! The goal was to implement the French version as well as add controller support. 

You said it was for early 2025

My personal environment changed rapidly afterward, and I couldn't gather the people necessary to finish the update. The update is stuck at 90% completion. Once it's finished, I'll make sure to let you know, but as it stands, I can't promise any date. Sorry about that :(

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44801201/09d51aac203497133cbb9e3e2015cc3ee4fb5dc6.png"]

To make up for it, here's a new visual of Reborn 2!
Reborn a Zombie 2 update status: Ongoing, and going well!
Now here's the big part!
Reborn a Zombie 2 is progressing nicely.
I've kept quiet this whole time in order to focus on giving everything I've got for this game! Here are the major milestones:

The game's first half is fully playable. You can try it out yourself via our Discord server.

The story of RaZ2 is structured around 2 chapters, each about the length of the first episode. This is the first half.

It still uses placeholder and temporary assets. So be mindful that it's still far from the finished version.

The second half is ongoing and progressing nicely.

I'm halfway done with coding that second half. Reborn a Zombie is written in a way that demands a lot of line-per-line coding and consideration when "directing" the game.

This is why it has taken a lot more time: Reborn a Zombie 2 is a lot more ambitious when it comes to acting and directing. I believe it will pay off in the end, and I hope you're looking forward to it.

The game is completed on its music!

The game is completed on its background art

The game is about 50% done on the character art department. This is where most of the workload is at the moment.

So, do we have a release date?

No! I don't want to announce a release date unless it's 100% certain.

Will it have a french version?

I'll try my best.

I want to play the game right now AAAAAH

Thank you! I can't wait either. If you want to have weekly updates on the game, please check out my Discord server. That's the best place to see more of what's happening behind the scene!



As always, thank you for being part of this journey. This kind of interaction with you people only make it more joyful.

notes.title: Devlog #3: 2024 Update and the Future of Reborn a Zombie
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44801201/99086fff497ad6f4e56e5adf2af6e00d6cb47dcc.png

A lot has changed in my life in 2024, but I’m happy to say things have been improving. Now, let’s dive into the news:

Reborn a Zombie: Major Update
When?
First half of 2025

What’s new?

 The game will be playable in French.
 Added game controller support.
 A post-credits teaser that will tie into Reborn a Zombie 2.

I personally handled the translation, and while it was a lot of work, it was also a lot of fun. I hope this will allow more people to enjoy the story.

Reborn a Zombie 2 is also expected to receive a French translation.

Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts is Progressing, but There’s Still Much to Do
When?
Tentatively 2026

Why the delay?
Depression.
I have a full-time job that demands a lot from me, and this passion project demands even more.

That said, I’m considering running a playtest to gather feedback on the first half of Reborn a Zombie 2. If you’re interested, join our Discord!

The Future of Reborn a Zombie and Asminae Games: Magii Archives
Initially, I planned to announce future games following Reborn a Zombie 2. However, the time required to create each game has made me cautious. What’s the point of announcing games if they might not be delivered?

That said, here’s what I can share:

Reborn a Zombie is part of Magii Archives, a shared universe encompassing all my future games. Think of it as a mix between the Marvel Cinematic Universe and Terry Pratchett’s Discworld in terms of continuity and shared universe.

Each new entry will stand alone but contribute to expanding this universe. Some will progress an overarching narrative, while others will explore fascinating aspects of this world.

Reborn a Zombie is the first series in this universe.

FAQ
Can I play games in any order I want?
Unless a game is a direct sequel, each story is designed to be enjoyable as a standalone. However, playing other games in the Magii Archives will add depth to the experience, as the lore and major events will have repercussion across multiple entries.

Are all Magii Archives games going to be kinetic, slice-of-life visual novels?
Not always. While the focus is on storytelling, I’m open to experimenting with gameplay styles.

Are all Magii Archives games going to be trans-themed?
Reborn a Zombie was born out of my desire to share my experience as a trans person through storytelling. But writing is my passion, and I’m excited to explore a wide range of ideas and experiences in this universe.

What’s Next?
I won’t announce a game until its script is 100% complete. This ensures I can deliver high-quality stories and avoid making false promises.

One such project was Lamia Panic. Although the script was completed in March 2023, its flaws outweighed its strengths. I decided it was best used for worldbuilding instead of a standalone release.

That said, Reborn a Zombie 3 is very likely to happen. No promises yet, but it’s high on my list.

I Want More!
Thank you for your support! The best way to stay updated is through my Discord server. There, you’ll find news on current projects and the Magii Archives universe.

I’m so excited to share these stories with you. I’ve worked in the game industry for five years. Yet, Reborn a Zombie 2 is my most ambitious project, and I’m incredibly proud of it. I hope you’ll enjoy the story as much as I’ve enjoyed creating it.

– Asminae and the Asminae Games Team
